Auto-applied to progress reports where this staff member is Class Teacher

Set these once — every month's payroll (Staff → Payroll tab) picks them up automatically, with nothing to re-enter. Nothing here is mandatory; leave EPF/ESI off if this staff member isn't registered for them. Enter the actual rupee amount deducted each month, not a percentage — EPF/ESI usually isn't calculated on the entire basic salary, so a flat % rarely matches what's really deducted.

Paid Leaves / Month is the number of Leave/Absent days each month that don't reduce pay (from Staff Attendance). Anything beyond that quota is deducted as Loss of Pay when payroll is generated.

Optional — only used to prefill the Salary Disbursement Report (Staff → Payroll) so it's ready to hand off to your bank or accountant. Nobody outside Payroll access can see this.

Add Subject

These are defaults — when this subject is added to a specific exam, its Countable/Elective setting can still be adjusted for that exam.

Add Subject

Every subject needs its own exam date before hall tickets (admit cards) can be generated for this class.

If "Countable" is off, this subject's marks won't be added into report card totals or percentages — useful for extracurriculars.

Add Exam

After saving, configure subjects separately for each class & section.

Exams usually run across several days — set each subject's own exam date under "Configure Subjects" after saving.

Find Duplicate Students

Students with the exact same first + last name (case-insensitive). Compare the details and delete the extras — keep whichever record has the most complete/correct info.

Notify Parents

Opens a WhatsApp message pre-filled with a fee reminder — sent one at a time, since browsers don't allow bulk auto-sending.
